apps.name: Esmarty
apps.description: Material You app voor het vinden en vergelijken van lokale prepaid-eSIMs.
apps.changelog: Esmarty 0.5.0 A major update that turns Esmarty into a more complete travel and local eSIM assistant. What's new: Added My Trips with a personal travel dashboard Added multi-country trip planning Added a data usage calculator for Maps, messaging, social media, music and video Added the Esmarty Score to help find the best prepaid eSIM for your trip Improved local provider, network and 5G information Added smarter eSIM comparison and recommendations Expanded the Wallet with installation and activation statuses Added automatic “Expiring soon” status without background notifications Added device and eSIM compatibility check Added step-by-step installation assistance Added arrival mode with a useful connectivity checklist Added an interactive troubleshooting assistant Prices are displayed in euros by default Only countries with verified local prepaid eSIM providers remain available Removed reminder and notification functionality Various interface, stability and usability improvements Esmarty remains privacy-friendly and performs most travel planning locally on your device.

apps.name: WeatherMe
apps.description: Material You weer-app met verwachtingen, waarschuwingen, radar en weerdetails.
apps.changelog: WeatherMe 2.4.0 Helder Weer heet vanaf deze versie WeatherMe. WeatherMe heeft een nieuwe internationale naam en een volledig nieuw app-icoon gekregen. De bestaande weerfunctionaliteit blijft behouden. Nieuw Helder Weer hernoemd naar WeatherMe Nieuw WeatherMe-appicoon Oude Helder Weer-vermeldingen in de interface en widgets vervangen Weerkaarten op het Weer-scherm kunnen nu worden gerangschikt Nieuwe Rangschikken-modus met sleephandvatten De gekozen volgorde van kaarten wordt automatisch opgeslagen Kaarten behouden tijdens normaal gebruik hun bestaande bediening Interactieve MapLibre-weerkaart met radar en neerslagverwachting behouden Nederlands en Engels worden automatisch gekozen op basis van de systeemtaal Widgets, waarschuwingen en neerslagmeldingen blijven beschikbaar English Helder Weer is now WeatherMe. WeatherMe introduces a new international name and a completely redesigned app icon while keeping all existing weather functionality. What's new Renamed Helder Weer to WeatherMe New WeatherMe app icon Replaced remaining Helder Weer branding throughout the app and widgets Weather cards on the Weather screen can now be reordered New reorder mode with drag handles Custom card order is automatically saved Normal card interaction remains unchanged outside reorder mode Interactive MapLibre weather map with radar and precipitation forecast retained Automatic Dutch/English interface based on system language Widgets, weather warnings and precipitation alerts remain available
